## Example 2.7(a) {#dc2-example-2-7-a .dc-lesson}

<p>Differentiate the following expressions with respect to <span data-math="x"></span>.</p><div class="dc-problem-list"><div><span class="part">a)</span><span data-math="y=x^2\log_e x"></span></div></div><p class="booklet-cue">Booklet p. 14 · Example 2.7(a)</p>

::: notes
The source uses log_e x; preserve that notation, then identify it with ln x in the working. Product rule: y'=2x ln x+x^2(1/x)=2x ln x+x=x(2 ln x+1). Domain x>0. Do not multiply the two derivatives. Around four minutes across both Example 2.7 slides.
:::
